exposure: mode of cesarean section (emergency vs. elective)
outcome: maternal transfer to higher care unit
cohort: 767 women who underwent cesarean section at a tertiary healthcare facility in Karachi, Pakistan between January 2020 and July 2021.
finding: Emergency cesarean sections were more prevalent among young, primigravida women with fetal complications, and were associated with higher maternal and neonatal complications compared to elective C-sections.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean sections were associated with significantly higher odds of maternal transfer to higher care units and neonatal intensive care unit admissions compared to elective cesarean sections.
